proposal.rationale: Chapter 4743 is another Ohio umbrella chapter that applies broadly to all boards/commissions/agencies under Title XLVII (Title 47, Occupations and Professions) or Chapter 3776. Sections 4743.01, 4743.03, 4743.04, and 4743.07 use phrases like "Each board, commission, or agency created under or by virtue of Title XLVII" and "issued under Title XLVII or Chapter 3776." These should be treated as universal at title-level (Title 47). We add patterns capturing "under ... Title XLVII" / "Title 47" phrasing as title-level universals. We also keep enumeration triggers — 4743.02 and 4743.05 enumerate practice-act chapters explicitly (introduced by "created under or by virtue of Chapters" and "money collected under Chapters"). Add those as trigger patterns. Sections like 4743.041, 4743.06, 4743.08, 4743.09 are genuinely section-scoped or board-subset-scoped — they should remain undetermined.
